description: A sharp finite classification of the strict curvature inflections of expected final infection generation in a one-step network epidemic on rooted trees.
limitations: The rooted-tree classification is exhaustive only through seven vertices.
Independent homogeneous one-step transmission and a single fixed initial infection are assumed.
The framework excludes cycles, heterogeneous transmission, multiple seeds, and continuous-time recovery.
A related 1990 Reed–Frost paper was accessible only through its abstract; bibliographic priority remains subject to independent checking.
scientific_integrity: The finite conclusion follows from a complete Prüfer-word census, exact polynomial probability calculations, exact algebraic root counts, and a separately computed edge-mask check. All code and the classwise certificate are embedded. No external scientific audit has been performed.
title: The seven-vertex threshold for two epidemic-duration curvature reversals
